description: The transcripts of Mohammed. No recipe reads them. Its transcripts are the Quran dataset's transcript table, inside archives that total about 24 GB, and a fetch holds a whole download in memory, so no fetch can read them (see https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/212).
